headline: On October 24, 2003: Concorde's Last Commercial Flight
captionCards: Concorde's first flight was on March 2, 1969
Concorde's legacy inspires future supersonic travel
instagramCaption:
Concorde takes its final bow in the skies. \\[Concorde, the iconic Anglo-French supersonic airliner, made its last commercial flight on October 24, 2003. The aircraft, jointly developed by Sud Aviation and BAC, had its first flight in 1969. Despite initial forecasts of 350 aircraft, only a few were ever built. This event marked the end of an era in aviation history. \\Why it still matters: Concorde's legacy continues to inspire future innovations in supersonic travel. \\What do you think was the most impressive feature of Concorde? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
